source_refs.note: Exercise 14.3, Question 16: moment about Q(4, 2, 2) of F = -2i + j - 3k acting at P, r = QP (book p.283). Answer key PDF 312: 15i - 15j - 15k.

blocks.prompt: 16. A force \(\underline{F} = -2\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\) is applied at \(P(-1, -3, 2)\). Find its moment about the point \(Q(4, 2, 2)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh moment of force (force ka ghumane wala asar) ka sawal hai.
Humein \(Q\) ke gird \(\underline{F}\) ka moment chahiye, jo ek vector hai.
Plan: pehle \(\underline{r} = \underline{QP}\), phir determinant se \(\underline{r} \times \underline{F}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: force \(\underline{F}\) jo point \(P(-1, -3, 2)\) se guzarti hai; point \(Q(4, 2, 2)\).
Humein find karna hai: \(Q\) ke gird \(\underline{F}\) ka moment (ghumane wala asar).
Tareeqa: Moment \(= \underline{r} \times \underline{F}\) (14.3.7 (c)). Yahan \(\underline{r}\) us point \(Q\) se, jis ke gird ghumana hai, force ki line wale point \(P\) tak ka vector hai. Misaal: darwaze ko qabze (hinge) ke gird ghumate hain; \(\underline{r}\) qabze se haath tak ka vector hai aur \(\underline{F}\) aap ka zor. Force components mein di hui hai, to seedha istemal hogi.

Force likhein
\[\underline{F} = -2\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Is ke components determinant ki teesri row banenge; missing component ho to wahan 0 likhna hai.

\(\underline{r} = \underline{QP}\) nikalein
\[\underline{QP} = (-1 - 4)\underline{i} + (-3 - 2)\underline{j} + (2 - 2)\underline{k}\]
\[= -5\underline{i} - 5\underline{j}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{r}\) hamesha us point se shuru hota hai jis ke gird moment chahiye (\(Q\)) aur force wale point (\(P\)) par khatam hota hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\underline{r}\) ulta le lein (\(P\) se \(Q\)) to moment ka sign ulta aa jayega; yeh sab se aam ghalti hai.

Determinant likhein
\[\underline{r} \times \underline{F} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ -5 & -5 & 0 \\ -2 & 1 & -3 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Pehli row mein unit vectors \(\underline{i}, \underline{j}, \underline{k}\), doosri row mein pehle vector ke components \(\underline{r}\), teesri row mein doosre vector ke components \(\underline{F}\). Rows ki tarteeb wohi honi chahiye jo product ki tarteeb hai, warna jawab ka sign ulta ho jayega.

Teenon minors nikalein
\[\underline{i}\text{ minor} = (-5)(-3) - (0)(1) = 15\]
\[\underline{j}\text{ minor} = (-5)(-3) - (0)(-2) = 15\]
\[\underline{k}\text{ minor} = (-5)(1) - (-5)(-2) = -15\]
Kyun: Har unit vector ki row aur column ko dhak dein (cover kar dein); jo 2 by 2 bachta hai us ka (upar baayan)(neeche daayan) minus (upar daayan)(neeche baayan) minor hai. Har product ko bracket mein likhne se negative signs ki ghalti nahi hoti.

Signs \(+, -, +\) lagayein
\[\underline{r} \times \underline{F} = \underline{i}(15) - \underline{j}(15) + \underline{k}(-15)\]
\[= 15\underline{i} - 15\underline{j} - 15\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Determinant ko pehli row ke saath kholte waqt signs ka pattern \(+, -, +\) hota hai, yani beech wala \(\underline{j}\) ka term minus ho kar aata hai.
Dhyan dein: Sab se zyada ghalti isi beech wale minus mein hoti hai; \(-\underline{j}(\text{minor})\) mein minor khud negative ho to jawab plus ban jata hai.

Moment ki miqdaar (magnitude)
\[|\underline{r} \times \underline{F}| = \sqrt{(15)^2 + (-15)^2 + (-15)^2}\]
\[= \sqrt{675} = 15 \sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: Lambai batati hai ke ghumane ka asar kitna taqatwar hai; sawal ne sirf moment maanga hai, magnitude izafi maloomat hai.

Tasdeeq
\[(\underline{r} \times \underline{F}) \cdot \underline{F} = (15)(-2) + (-15)(1) + (-15)(-3)\]
\[= -30 - 15 + 45 = 0\]
Kyun: Moment \(\underline{r} \times \underline{F}\) cross product hai, is liye \(\underline{F}\) (aur \(\underline{r}\)) dono par perpendicular hona chahiye. Dot product zero aaya, to hisaab sahi hai.
